build_volume_mm.rationale: Placeholder volume for a user-supplied generic resin machine; replace before use.

dimensional_safety_margin_mm.rationale: Project starting margin; plate and vat clearances remain machine-specific.

nozzle_diameter_mm.rationale: Nozzle is not a resin-process parameter; value is retained only for a common profile shape and must not drive resin evaluation.

nominal_layer_height_mm.rationale: Example resin layer height; replace with the selected machine/material setting.

wall_thickness_warning_mm.rationale: Conservative generic project starting point; cited manufacturer values are process-specific and are not copied as a universal limit.

wall_thickness_critical_mm.rationale: Project review boundary below the generic warning value; material, orientation, wash, and cure are not modeled.

minimum_feature_warning_mm.rationale: Generic feature proxy starting point; do not treat as a resin printer guarantee.

minimum_feature_critical_mm.rationale: Project review boundary; feature height and peel/support conditions are not modeled.

overhang_warning_angle_deg.rationale: Warning angle from the horizontal plane under the documented downward-face convention; process-specific.

overhang_critical_angle_deg.rationale: More severe downward slope; support and peel behavior are not simulated.

build_plate_contact_tolerance_mm.rationale: Numerical contact tolerance only; it is not a resin adhesion setting.

bridge_guidance.description: Bridge simulation is deferred for resin; review unsupported spans in the selected resin workflow.

support_assumption.description: Supports, orientation, and unsupported islands require user review; support generation is deferred.

notes: Project-default example only. Hollowing, drain holes, suction, and support generation are deferred and not evaluated.
